evals.prompt: 我给你一个学校毕业论文 DOCX 模板和论文标题、作者、摘要、关键词，请按模板生成可交付 DOCX/PDF，字体字号页眉页脚都不能乱。
evals.expected_output: A filled DOCX/PDF plus analysis, font-plan, render, verification, pipeline JSON, pipeline Markdown delivery summary, delivery-gate JSON/Markdown reports, and when requested a delivery ZIP package with manifest. analyze_template.py should inventory Word bookmarks, existing hyperlinks, and content controls across body, headers, footers, footnotes, and endnotes, including part, tag, alias, level, text, kind, lock, showing_placeholder, text_control, target, relationship_id, and spec_candidate where applicable. Named bookmarks should produce bookmark_text spec candidates and be filled by replacing only the bookmark range or inserting into an empty bookmark without stripping bookmarkStart/bookmarkEnd metadata; empty bookmark insertions should inherit neighboring run formatting when available and report run_style_source. Existing hyperlink fields should be replaceable through locator_type hyperlink, preserving the w:hyperlink wrapper and run/paragraph formatting while optionally updating the external relationship target in .rels with report evidence. New hyperlink fields should be insertable from ordinary placeholders, literal text, or text anchors with replacement_mode insert_hyperlink, creating a w:hyperlink wrapper plus an External hyperlink relationship in the current text part .rels and recording expected_structure_change hyperlink_inserted. When --auto-content-controls is used and data fields match content-control tag/alias/dataBinding values, render_pipeline.py should generate an auto content-control spec and render through fill_by_spec.py without a hand-written spec. Render reports should include text format checks for ordinary text fields, and verify_fidelity.py should report tracked_text_format_preserved so font/size/bold/color/style drift around edited fields is not silently missed. Single-paragraph multiline values should be materialized as Word w:br elements, with line_breaks_inserted and expected_structure_change recorded in the render report. Long body fields should use reference_block paragraph cloning when a reference DOCX is provided, including missing style definition merge, direct numbering definition migration, missing-style internal numbering migration, external hyperlink relationship migration, embedded image relationship/media migration, footnote/endnote migration, comment migration when needed, and complex structure guardrails for field codes or tracked revisions. Word content controls should be filled without stripping SDT tag/alias/dataBinding/lock metadata; controls marked with w:showingPlcHdr should have that placeholder-state marker removed after successful filling and report placeholder_removed/content_control_placeholder_removed; plain text controls with w:text/w:multiLine should preserve and report text_control.multi_line while multiline values are rendered as w:br; empty styled runs that only contain w:rPr should be reused so font/size/bold properties are preserved rather than inserting unstyled runs or paragraphs; contentLocked and sdtContentLocked controls should be blocked by default unless allow_locked_content_control is explicit; checkbox, date, dropdown/comboBox, and repeatingSection controls should use their explicit replacement modes rather than ordinary text fallback. Section-specific headers/footers that resolve to a linked previous section should be blocked by default unless allow_linked_section_part is explicit. Missing fonts, page-count changes, unresolved placeholders, PDF font substitutions, optional multi-page visual diff results, and any visual ignore/dynamic whitelist regions must be reported and reflected in the delivery gate.
expectations: The workflow runs analyze_template.py, prepare_fonts.py, a renderer, and verify_fidelity.py or render_pipeline.py.
The analysis report includes complex_structures counts and samples for field codes, field instructions, equations, revisions, embedded objects, altChunk, drawings, and comment anchors where present.

When the user needs Word fields such as TOC, page numbers, cross-references, dates, or auto-numbering to refresh on open, render_pipeline.py --request-field-update writes a field-update report, sets w:updateFields=true in word/settings.xml, and the verifier allows that settings.xml change only with this report evidence. The workflow still states that this is a refresh request, not command-line field calculation.

When the user asks the robot to actually refresh Word field results, render_pipeline.py --refresh-fields creates a sidecar field-refresh report, field-refreshed DOCX/PDF when possible, field-refreshed verification report, pipeline JSON, pipeline Markdown delivery summary, and delivery-gate JSON/Markdown report. The report's actual_field_results_refresh value is the authority: false means request-only or unavailable backend, true means an external Word/LibreOffice CLI/UNO backend attempted the refresh. field-refresh.json must include post_refresh_drift so external-engine package rewrites of core parts such as styles, fontTable, numbering, theme, settings, content types, text parts, relationships, or media are visible, and pipeline summary should surface the drift counts/core-risk parts under field_refresh_status.post_refresh_drift while the Markdown summary lists field refresh evidence and package drift for human review. check_delivery.py can be run with --require-actual-field-refresh to block request-only or unproven field refresh claims. The sidecar's own verification report must be checked before treating the refreshed file as deliverable.

The pipeline writes delivery_gate status into its JSON summary and creates <stem>.delivery.json / <stem>.delivery.md. A blocked delivery gate prevents delivery; needs_review requires explicit human acceptance; ready is only valid for the scope covered by the current pipeline options.

package_delivery.py can turn a pipeline JSON into a ZIP package containing manifest.json, README.txt, output files, reports, delivery gate, and Markdown summaries. It refuses blocked delivery gates by default and requires --include-blocked for evidence packaging.

Before relying on a local Word/LibreOffice field-refresh backend for production claims, run_field_refresh_live_check.py should be available to generate a stale PAGE field fixture and prove whether the backend actually changes the field result.
Header, footer, footnote, and endnote text changes are allowed only when placeholders or approved dynamic regions explain the change.
The analysis report lists content_controls from all text parts and each content control with tag or alias includes a usable spec_candidate.

The analysis report lists named bookmarks from all text parts; usable non-hidden, non-system bookmarks include bookmark_text spec_candidate entries and draft_spec.py promotes only those usable bookmarks into bookmark fields. Word/WPS/tool-generated bookmarks such as _Toc..., MTUpdateHome, OLE_LINK..., or DDE_LINK... are ignored as business fields or reported separately.

With --auto-content-controls and matching data fields, render_pipeline.py writes <stem>.auto-content-controls.spec.json, renders matching content controls through fill_by_spec.py, and reports the matched fields.

For L1 placeholders and L2 ordinary text fields, render reports include text_format_checks or per-field format_check entries, and verify_fidelity.py passes tracked_text_format_preserved only when the tracked pPr/rPr/sdtPr format signatures are preserved.

When L1 or L2 single-paragraph fields contain newline characters, render_docx.py and fill_by_spec.py materialize them as w:br, report line_breaks_inserted plus expected_structure_change line_breaks_inserted, and verify_fidelity.py allows only this documented structure change.

When fields target Word bookmarks, fill_by_spec.py reports action bookmark_text_replace, preserves bookmarkStart/bookmarkEnd metadata, replaces only text inside the bookmark range, marks empty-bookmark run insertion as expected_structure_change bookmark_empty_range_inserted, and for empty bookmarks inherits the nearest neighboring run properties with run_style_source evidence when available.

For table_loops, render reports include row/cell format_check entries comparing the template row to every inserted row, and tracked_text_format_preserved fails if trPr, tcPr, pPr, or rPr signatures drift.

When fields target Word content controls by tag or alias, ordinary text filling reports action content_control_text, preserves w:sdt, w:sdtPr, w:sdtContent, tag, alias, and text_control metadata, removes w:showingPlcHdr placeholder-state markers after successful fill with placeholder_removed evidence, and verify_fidelity.py reports content_controls_preserved as passed.

When a plain text Word content control has w:text/w:multiLine enabled, analyze_template.py, draft_spec.py, render_pipeline.py --auto-content-controls, fill_by_spec.py, and verify_fidelity.py preserve and report text_control.multi_line, and multiline values are rendered as w:br with line_breaks_inserted evidence.

When a targeted Word content control contains an empty w:r with only w:rPr, fill_by_spec.py should insert text into that existing run, report run_reused, preserve direct font/size/bold run properties, keep run-level controls run-level, and pass tracked_text_format_preserved.

When fields target contentLocked or sdtContentLocked Word content controls, analyze_template.py, draft_spec.py, and auto content-control specs preserve the lock value; fill_by_spec.py blocks by default with content_control_locked unless allow_locked_content_control is explicit, and allowed fills report content_control_lock.

When fields target Word content controls by dataBinding, analyze_template.py should extract xpath/storeItemID/prefixMappings, draft_spec.py and auto content-control specs should be able to derive a field key from the binding XPath, fill_by_spec.py should locate by binding, fill visible content, attempt to update the matching customXml item, report custom_xml_update, and verify_fidelity.py should confirm the binding metadata is preserved.

When fields target checkbox content controls, analyze_template.py and draft_spec.py should classify them as replacement_mode checkbox, fill_by_spec.py should report action content_control_checkbox with checked/display_text, and verify_fidelity.py should still pass content_controls_preserved.

When fields target date content controls, analyze_template.py should extract fullDate/dateFormat/lid/storeMappedDataAs/calendar, draft_spec.py and auto content-control specs should classify them as replacement_mode date, fill_by_spec.py should report action content_control_date with selected_display_text/full_date/date_before/date and update w:fullDate for ISO date values, and verify_fidelity.py should still pass content_controls_preserved.

When fields target dropdown or comboBox content controls, analyze_template.py should extract listItem options, draft_spec.py and auto content-control specs should classify them as replacement_mode choice, fill_by_spec.py should report action content_control_choice with selected_display_text/selected_value/matched_option/options, dropdown invalid values should fail with choice_value_not_in_options, and verify_fidelity.py should still pass content_controls_preserved.

When fields target repeatingSection content controls, analyze_template.py should detect w15 repeatingSection/repeatingSectionItem by local-name, draft_spec.py and auto content-control specs should classify them as replacement_mode repeating_section, fill_by_spec.py should clone the existing repeatingSectionItem sample block for each data row, report action content_control_repeating_section with items_created/token_counts, and verify_fidelity.py should allow only render-report-backed repeated item content-control count changes.

When fields target section-specific headers or footers, part_resolution records the requested section index, source section index, kind, reference type, resolved part, and whether the part is linked to a previous section; linked previous-section parts are blocked by default with section_part_linked_to_previous unless allow_linked_section_part is explicit.
When a reference DOCX is available for long body text, reference_block reports reference_paragraphs_used and paragraphs_created instead of flattening the whole body into one paragraph.

When templates contain existing external hyperlinks, analyze_template.py inventories text/target/relationship_id/spec_candidate, draft_spec.py reports hyperlink candidates without auto-filling them, fill_by_spec.py supports locator_type hyperlink values as either display text strings or {text,url} objects, preserves the w:hyperlink wrapper, updates .rels targets only when requested, and verify_fidelity.py passes tracked_text_format_preserved from the render report.

When a normal placeholder, literal text, or text_anchor should become a new external hyperlink, fill_by_spec.py supports replacement_mode insert_hyperlink, creates or reuses a hyperlink relationship with TargetMode External, inserts a w:hyperlink wrapper, reports action hyperlink_insert plus expected_structure_change hyperlink_inserted, and verify_fidelity.py allows only this report-backed structure change.

When reference_block imports styles not present in the template, reference_styles.merged_style_ids records the copied style definitions and the verifier only allows word/styles.xml changes when this evidence exists.

When reference_block source paragraphs use a styleId that already exists in the target template but has a different style definition, fill_by_spec.py reports reference_style_conflicts with reference_styles.existing_style_definition_conflicts and blocks by default unless allow_reference_style_conflicts is explicit.

When reference_block imports direct paragraph numbering or numbering bound inside copied missing styles, reference_numbering.imported_num_ids records the copied numbering definitions, cloned paragraphs/styles remap old numId values, and the verifier only allows word/numbering.xml changes when this evidence exists.
When reference_block clones paragraphs containing external hyperlinks, reference_relationships records imported or reused hyperlink relationships and cloned paragraphs remap old r:id values.

When reference_block clones paragraphs containing embedded images, reference_relationships.embedded_images records imported/reused image relationships, copied media paths, and remapped r:embed values.
When reference_block clones paragraphs containing footnotes or endnotes, reference_notes records copied notes, new note IDs, and remapped note references.
When reference_block clones paragraphs containing comments, reference_comments records copied comments, new comment IDs, and remapped comment anchors/references.

When reference_block source paragraphs contain field codes or tracked revisions, reference_complex_structures records the detected tags and rendering is blocked unless allow_reference_complex_structures is explicitly set.
Cross-run placeholders such as split {{客户 / 名称}} tokens are replaced or explicitly reported as unresolved.
The final report names missing fonts, page-count changes, unresolved placeholders, PDF font substitutions, and visual diff results when enabled.

evals.prompt: 我从学校官网下载了一个毕业论文 DOCX 模板，里面没有 {{字段}}，只写了“[此处键入中文标题]”“摘要内容。”这种示例文本。你直接帮我 100% 自动排完整篇论文。
evals.expected_output: The skill should classify the template as L2 unless analysis finds placeholders, named bookmarks, tagged/aliased content controls, or another stable spec locator. It may use strict literal_replacements for explicit sample text, but it must not claim automatic full-field recognition from a plain format sample. It should recommend adding placeholders/bookmarks/content-control tags, providing a reference DOCX, or creating a template_spec.json before long-body thesis generation.
expectations: The workflow can run assess_template_readiness.py before production rendering to classify a real DOCX template as L1/L2/L3, produce a readiness score, name blockers, and refuse a 100% claim when stable field locators are missing.

Readiness scoring treats field codes, equations, tracked revisions, embedded objects, and altChunk as complex Word structures that require explicit handling and visual/PDF verification before any 100% fidelity claim.

For field-code-heavy thesis templates, --request-field-update may be used to request Word-side refresh on open, and --refresh-fields may be used to produce a sidecar refreshed DOCX/PDF when Word or LibreOffice automation is available. The answer must not equate either path with completed recalculation unless run_field_refresh_live_check.py has proven the local backend, field-refresh.json reports actual_field_results_refresh=true, and follow-up PDF/visual checks pass.
The workflow first runs analyze_template.py and reports placeholders, content_controls, bookmarks or other stable locators.
If placeholders are empty and content controls have no tag/alias or are only page-number controls, the task is classified as L2, not L1.
System or tool-generated bookmarks such as _Toc..., MTUpdateHome, OLE_LINK..., or DDE_LINK... do not count as stable business locators for readiness scoring or draft spec generation.

For one-off DOCX format samples, draft_spec.py or render_pipeline.py --draft-spec is used to generate a conservative template_spec draft, TODO data scaffold, literal replacement candidates, and warnings before production rendering.

If draft_spec.py finds zero placeholders, tagged content controls, usable bookmarks, hyperlinks, or conservative visible sample fields, it emits a no_stable_fields warning instead of silently producing an empty draft.
When --draft-spec is used with render_pipeline.py and no explicit spec is supplied, the generated draft spec is reported and used for fill_by_spec.py rendering of confirmed fields.

Drafted visible-sample fields should use literal_text_replace or equivalent cross-text-node replacement so existing run and paragraph formatting is preserved and tracked_text_format_preserved does not fail.
Explicit sample text such as title, abstract, and keywords may be replaced through literal_replacements with --strict, and unused literals must fail rather than be ignored.

The answer does not promise 100% automatic field recognition for long body text, chapter structure, figures, tables, or references without a reference DOCX, spec, placeholders, bookmarks, or tagged content controls.
verify_fidelity.py with --render-report is used after rendering, and missing fonts remain warnings or failures even when text replacement succeeds.

evals.prompt: 把这个合同模板里的客户名、项目名、报价明细、付款节点换成新项目，表格样式和签署页保持原样。
evals.expected_output: A cloned-template DOCX where only intended fields changed, dropdown or comboBox content controls such as payment method and invoice type are filled through choice validation, conditional_blocks keep/remove optional clauses or fee rows, table_loops clone the template rows for quote/payment details including nested table loops when needed, optional image_fields replace existing logo/seal images, and core style/numbering/font parts are unchanged.
expectations: The output uses the original DOCX as the base file and changes only intended text-bearing nodes or cloned table rows.
conditional_blocks report kept/removed/error and do not leave {{#if ...}} or {{/if ...}} marker paragraphs unresolved.

table_loops report the number of inserted rows, table_match details including table_depth for nested tables, and row/cell format_check evidence proving inserted rows preserved the template row formatting.
image_fields report replaced media paths or explicit image errors when logos, seals, or figure images are provided.
verify_fidelity.py reports core invariant parts unchanged, text-part structure preserved, and content_controls_preserved when the template contains Word content controls.

Dropdown content-control values are checked against the template's listItem options, while comboBox custom values are allowed only when the field mode permits them and the render report records custom_value.

evals.prompt: 我只有一份 PDF 模板，没有 Word 源文件，但希望你 100% 复刻格式。
evals.expected_output: The skill should refuse a 100% guarantee, classify it as L3 visual imitation, and explain that editable DOCX fidelity requires a DOCX template.
expectations: The answer does not promise 100% editable DOCX fidelity from only a PDF or screenshot.
The answer classifies the job as L3 visual imitation and asks for an editable DOCX template for high-fidelity output.

evals.prompt: 我有两份已经填好的报价单 DOCX，不知道模板原文件在哪了。你帮我反推出可复用模板，下次我只填客户名和报价明细就能生成新报价单。
evals.expected_output: A template inference report, placeholder DOCX template, inferred spec, and a rendered test DOCX. Paragraph fields, text_part_fields for headers/footers/notes, conservative whole-paragraph conditional blocks, obvious optional table-row conditional blocks, and table loops should be identified, reviewed, then verified with no unresolved placeholders.
expectations: infer_template.py produces an inference report, placeholder DOCX template, and spec.
The inferred paragraph fields, text-part fields, conditional_blocks, and table loops are reviewed before production rendering.

When a direct body paragraph exists in the first filled sample and is absent from at least one other sample, infer_template.py reports a conditional paragraph block, inserts marker_pair delimiters in the placeholder template, emits conditional_blocks in the spec, and fill_by_spec.py can keep or remove it without leaving markers.

When an internal table row in the first filled sample has obvious optional wording such as warranty/support/service fee/discount, is absent from another sample, and its surrounding row anchors are still present, infer_template.py reports a conditional_table_row block, emits a table_row_contains conditional with locator.table_index, and does not misclassify the optional row or a Total row as a table_loop.
The rendered test output is verified with no unresolved placeholders.

evals.prompt: 我刚改了 template-fidelity-renderer 的脚本，你帮我确认没有把页眉页脚、表格循环、反推模板和视觉忽略这些能力改坏。
evals.expected_output: The regression runner should be executed and should report pass/fail for header/footer text structure, tracked text-format preservation plus a negative drift case, table-loop row/cell format preservation plus a negative drift case, section-specific header/footer parts, linked previous-section header/footer guardrails, L1/L2 multiline w:br rendering, bookmark text replacement and empty bookmark insertion with neighboring run style inheritance, existing hyperlink text/URL replacement with .rels preservation, new hyperlink insertion with External .rels relationship evidence, content control text filling plus w:showingPlcHdr placeholder-state cleanup and w:text/w:multiLine preservation, empty styled content-control run reuse, content control lock guardrails, content control dataBinding filling plus customXml writeback, content control checkbox filling, content control date filling plus fullDate update, content control dropdown choice filling and invalid-option failure, content control repeatingSection cloning, field update request reporting, field refresh sidecar request-only boundary reporting, pipeline Markdown delivery summary generation, delivery gate ready/needs_review/blocked decisions, delivery ZIP packaging with blocked-gate refusal, auto content-control pipeline rendering, cross-run placeholders, spec top-level and nested table loops, spec header/footer parts, spec image fields, spec conditional blocks, reference block paragraph cloning including style/numbering/hyperlink/image/notes/comments migration, reference block complex structure guardrails, template inference including conditional paragraph and conditional table-row inference, and visual ignore presets.
expectations: run_regression_tests.py is executed after script changes.

The regression report includes test_header_footer_text_structure, test_cross_run_placeholders, test_multiline_line_break_rendering, test_spec_bookmark_text_replace, test_spec_hyperlink_field, test_spec_hyperlink_insert, test_spec_content_control_text, test_spec_content_control_empty_run_style, test_spec_content_control_lock_guard, test_spec_content_control_databinding, test_spec_content_control_checkbox, test_spec_content_control_choice, test_spec_content_control_date, test_spec_content_control_repeating_section, test_draft_spec_from_template, test_request_field_update_pipeline, test_template_readiness_assessment, test_spec_table_loop, test_spec_nested_table_loop, test_spec_header_footer_part, test_spec_section_header_footer_part, test_spec_section_linked_header_guard, test_spec_image_field, test_spec_conditional_blocks, test_reference_block_clone, test_reference_block_style_conflict_guard, test_reference_block_complex_structure_guard, test_infer_template_smoke, test_infer_template_conditional_paragraphs, test_infer_template_conditional_table_rows, test_delivery_gate, and test_visual_ignore_config.
Any failed regression is treated as a blocker before claiming the skill is ready.
